intent: Specify the public permutation API of `arxid::permute`: `obfuscate`, `deobfuscate`, `feistel_n` and `feistel_n_inv`.

manual_mutants.note: both directions use 5 rounds: still a permutation of the domain, but not feistel_n at (ROUNDS, WIDTH_BITS)
both directions use a 42-bit width: round trip still holds on the domain, outputs leave the domain
odd widths round the half width up in both directions (inverse still holds, range breaks)

edits.after: let half ← (do let w ← width + 1#u32; w / 2#u32)
let half ← (do let w ← width + 1#u32; w / 2#u32)

manual_mutants.note: deobfuscate masks to 39 bits: round trip fails only for ids with bit 39 set
zero rounds requested by a caller is treated as one round in feistel_n only
manual_mutants.before: permute.feistel_n_loop { start := 0#usize, «end» := rounds } key half l r
manual_mutants.after: permute.feistel_n_loop { start := 0#usize, «end» := (if rounds = 0#usize then 1#usize else rounds) } key half l r

bug_variants.note: spec v1 key schedule folds the 64-bit word with lo XOR hi: complementing the key complements both halves, the XOR cancels it, so key and !key give the same permutation (effective key space 2^63)
